summary: The messaging-faults eval counts a seat host's read whether this build records it as a claim or as a local mark, so the link-minutes case in main upkeep's perf-cost job checks the read again. Tests only.

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or schema version change.

compatibility.detail: No product change. The eval still requires exactly one read of the message on the seat's host, and that it is the reader's own receipt: a read mark by receipt id, a read claim by its time and id.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs before the daemon serves.

recovery.detail: No product change; rolling back is unaffected.
